name: arch-kele-structure-photo
title_zh: 把一张照片拆成带分析线的水彩结构分解图
tagline_zh: 给建筑/产品照片做编辑级结构图解：暖纸底色、拆解构图、克制标注，源图缩略嵌右上角，几何关系一眼可读。
tagline_en: Turn one photo into two editorial watercolor study plates—exploded geometry, warm paper, restrained labels.
desc_en: Transform one supplied photograph into two matching editorial structural-study images—one clean artwork without the source photo and one version with the unchanged source photo inset at the upper-right—while preserving recognizable geometry in an airy exploded or layered watercolor composition with warm paper, analytical construction lines, restrained labels, and a source-derived palette. Use when
why_zh: 同一张源图同时产出干净版和带源图对照版，构图线、色板全部从照片推导，不是套滤镜，是重新画一张结构图。
why_en: Derives palette, construction lines, and exploded layout from the actual photo—two plates from one source, not a filter but a.
limit_zh: 只吃单张输入照片；输出固定为两张匹配图，不做多图拼版或视频帧。水彩风格预设，不接写实渲染或矢量线稿。源图需清晰可辨。
limit_en: Single input photo only; outputs exactly two matched plates. Fixed watercolor style—no photorealism or vector linework. Blurry snapshots fail.
